model: Proper conjugate Normal–Inverse-Gamma spatial regression with physical-section nuisance random intercepts
response: y=ln(1+raw MERFISH imaging count); no normalization or raw-count back-transformation
likelihood: y = X beta + section_offset + epsilon; epsilon~N(0,sigma²), section_offset~N(0,0.25 sigma²); working Gaussian model is approximate for zero-heavy nonnegative data.
features: 36 Gaussian RBFs with anisotropic physical lengths
why_no_celltype_predictors: Atlas expression-derived class/subclass labels could leak the target transcript; they are not used to construct features.

basis.centers: Cartesian product of training-coordinate quantiles only
basis.training_only_centering: Coordinate means/SD and mean RBF feature values are learned only from the training cells. Outcome is not centered or scaled.

posterior.solver: Cholesky; normal-equation and residual-plus-prior quadratic checks recorded
posterior.latent_scale2: bn/an * x.T Vn x, plus independent prior variance for unseen anatomy
posterior.predictive_scale2: bn/an * (1+0.25+x.T Vn x), plus independent prior variance for unseen anatomy

target: Section-adjusted spatial conditional mean; physical-section nuisance offset averaged to zero. New-cell predictive distribution integrates a NEW section offset, at the actual measured coordinate. No new cell is instantiated.
unseen_anatomy: Training vocabulary only. Unknown test anatomy has zero prior mean and an added independent anatomy-prior variance; it is never silently treated as a known group.

validation.scheme: Five contiguous blocks of whole physical sections, ordered by acquisition AP/experimental_z
validation.fold_assignment: Deterministic array_split of ordered region sections; all cells in each test section held out together. No cell/section exclusion by expression.
validation.guard: Nearest represented region section immediately before and after each test block removed from training; guard may exceed one acquisition cut if region is absent from intervening cuts. Exact labels and AP distances recorded.
validation.hyperparameters: All fixed before CV; no held-out tuning or model selection. All four sensitivity variants are reported regardless of performance.
validation.gene_selection: Ten measured candidates per region frozen by prior bulk-results selection; no atlas-outcome selection.

baselines.anatomy_constant: Proper Bayesian global/anatomical intercept model, same prior and section nuisance structure; training cells only.
baselines.knn: Unweighted average of30 nearest training cells in same anatomy when≥30available, otherwise all training anatomies; distances scaled by fixed primary AP/DV/ML lengths. No uncertainty interval assigned to deterministic interpolation.

conditional_tail_metrics: coverage_positive and coverage_zero condition on realized outcomes and are descriptive tail-recovery diagnostics. They need not equal the nominal marginal 95%level, even under a calibrated marginal predictive interval. The positive-tail flag is not a formal calibration test.
interval_scope: Conditional on fixed kernel lengths, prior variances, anatomy labels and Gaussian likelihood; no residual spatial-correlation, registration-error or between-animal uncertainty model. Cell-wise calibration is descriptive; sections/donors are not independent cell replicates.
interpretation_limits: Gaussian fitted means, latent intervals and predictive distributions can be negative on the physically nonnegative ln(1 + count) scale. Predictive negative mass is quantified; fitted quantities and intervals are never clipped or presented as raw-count predictions.
Latent-mean credible intervals are not new-cell predictive intervals; empirical coverage is assessed only for the latter.
Full-reference posterior arrays are in-sample fitted spatial summaries; held-out metrics come exclusively from refits excluding test/guard sections.
No PM response, differential expression, protein abundance, additional resolution, missing-gene expression, new positions, cell generation, mirroring or relocation is inferred.

computational_limits.basis: 36 finite-rank RBFs, no Gaussian-process or neural-network fit
computational_limits.posterior_integration: Exact conjugate algebra; no MCMC, approximate optimization or convergence diagnostic required.
computational_limits.hyperparameter_uncertainty: Length scales, anatomy/section prior variances and basis size are fixed, not integrated out.
computational_limits.residual_dependence: After section nuisance effects, remaining spatial dependence and heteroscedasticity are not modeled.
computational_limits.resolution: No additional spatial resolution or unmeasured-gene/cell information is created.
